text:
maya: Heads up — noticed a spike in late lines for the telemetry aggregate between 03:00-04:00 UTC, looks like sampling dropped to 10% and then back to 100%.
liam: got a link to the logs? which pipeline? :eyes:
maya: it's the ingestion worker group `telemetry-writer-prod` — saw retries and a sampling toggle flip in the same minute. logs: https://logs.internal/xyz
anika: was there a console change? I remember the new sampling-window toggle shipped yesterday.
maya: yep, that toggle is the one. UI sets sampling to 10% during "priority window" to keep costs low for heavy backfills.
sam: that sounds risky for recompute accuracy. if sampling changes mid-window aggregates will be biased.
liam: can we diff the agg counts? quick query:
```
SELECT hour, count(*) FROM telemetry_events WHERE hour BETWEEN '2026-03-18 02:00' AND '2026-03-18 05:00' GROUP BY hour;
```
maya: pulled counts, hour 03 had 40% drop vs expected, 02 and 04 fine.
anika: we should show a console warning when sampling < 50% AND there's a scheduled recompute for same window. UX oversight.
product-tim: Agreed — product ok to add an inline banner. what's the smallest change tho? maybe disable auto-sampling during recomputes.
maya: disabling auto-sample during recomputes might blow cost. compromise: show banner + require explicit opt-in to reduce sampling during recompute.
sam: ops perspective — recompute job should record sampling rate and emit a "sampled" flag per-hour so we can correct estimates later.
liam: also add metadata to reprocess run: `sampling_rate` and `console_override=true|false`.
anika: I'll add a console flag and banner. proposal: add a confirmation modal when a user schedules recompute and sampling < 50% that shows estimated error and cost delta.
maya: can we also backfill the missing sample? i.e., re-run recompute in full for hours impacted only. we need a policy: if sampled <25% then auto-enqueue full reprocess.
sam: agree on policy. but need quota gating. If we auto-enqueue, it should go to low-priority queue unless customer has dedicated capacity.
product-tim: noted. we'll do: banner + confirm modal + record sampling metadata + auto-enqueue policy for <25% sampling into low-priority queue.
anika: I'll PR UX copy tonight. pinging @eng-sre for quota gating help.
ops-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-332 telemetry-sampling-recompute-warning
liam: thanks. can someone add a short telemetry eval to detect "sampling toggles during recompute" to alert future?
maya: adding eval to the reprocess job now.
sam: one more — docs update in runbook about interpreting recompute aggregates when sampling variance exists.
maya: ok will draft.
